pli-tv-pvr13:1.2: “yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ codesi, kimhi naṃ codesi, sīlavipattiyā codesi, ācāravipattiyā codesi, diṭṭhivipattiyā codesī”ti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.4: “sīlavipattiyā vā codemi, ācāravipattiyā vā codemi, diṭṭhivipattiyā vā codemī”ti. so evamassa vacanīyo :
pli-tv-pvr13:1.5: “jānāsi panāyasmā sīlavipattiṃ, jānāsi ācāravipattiṃ, jānāsi diṭṭhivipatti”nti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.7: “jānāmi kho ahaṃ āvuso sīlavipattiṃ, jānāmi ācāravipattiṃ. jānāmi diṭṭhivipatti”nti. so evamassa vacanīyo :
pli-tv-pvr13:1.12: “cattāri ca pārājikāni terasa saṅghādisesā, ayaṃ sīlavipatti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.13: thullaccayaṃ pācittiyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ dukkaṭaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ, ayaṃ ācāravipatti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.14: micchādiṭṭhi antaggāhikā diṭṭhi, ayaṃ diṭṭhivipattī”ti, so evamassa vacanīyo :
pli-tv-pvr13:1.15: “yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ codesi, diṭṭhena codesi sutena codesi parisaṅkāya codesī”ti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.17: “diṭṭhena vā codemi, sutena vā codemi, parisaṅkāya vā codemī”ti, so evamassa vacanīyo :
pli-tv-pvr13:1.18: “yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ codesi, diṭṭhena codesi, kinte diṭṭhaṃ, kinti te diṭṭhaṃ, kadā te diṭṭhaṃ, kattha te diṭṭhaṃ, pārājikaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho, saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho, thullaccayaṃ …pe…
pli-tv-pvr13:1.22: dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpajjanto diṭṭho. kattha ca tvaṃ ahosi, kattha cāyaṃ bhikkhu ahosi, kiñca tvaṃ karosi, kiñcāyaṃ bhikkhu karotī”ti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.24: “na kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ diṭṭhena codemi, api ca sutena codemī”ti. so evamassa vacanīyo :
pli-tv-pvr13:1.25: “yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ sutena codesi, kinte sutaṃ, kinti te sutaṃ, kadā te sutaṃ, kattha te sutaṃ, pārājikaṃ ajjhāpannoti sutaṃ, saṅghādisesaṃ …pe…
pli-tv-pvr13:1.30: dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpannoti sutaṃ, bhikkhussa sutaṃ, bhikkhuniyā sutaṃ, sikkhamānāya sutaṃ, sāmaṇerassa sutaṃ, sāmaṇeriyā sutaṃ, upāsakassa sutaṃ, upāsikāya sutaṃ, rājūnaṃ sutaṃ, rājamahāmattānaṃ sutaṃ, titthiyānaṃ sutaṃ, titthiyasāvakānaṃ suta”nti.
pli-tv-pvr13:1.32: “na kho ahaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ sutena codemi, api ca parisaṅkāya codemī”ti so evamassa vacanīyo :
pli-tv-pvr13:1.33: “yaṃ kho tvaṃ āvuso imaṃ bhikkhuṃ parisaṅkāya codesi, kiṃ parisaṅkasi, kinti parisaṅkasi, kadā parisaṅkasi, kattha parisaṅkasi, pārājikaṃ ajjhāpannoti parisaṅkasi, saṅghādisesaṃ …pe… thullaccayaṃ …pe…
pli-tv-pvr13:1.37: dubbhāsitaṃ ajjhāpannoti parisaṅkasi, bhikkhussa sutvā parisaṅkasi, bhikkhuniyā …pe… sikkhamānāya …pe… sāmaṇerassa …pe… sāmaṇeriyā …pe… upāsakassa …pe… upāsikāya …pe… rājūnaṃ …pe… rājamahāmattānaṃ …pe… titthiyānaṃ …pe… titthiyasāvakānaṃ sutvā parisaṅkasī”ti.
pli-tv-pvr13:5.1: codanāya ko ādi, kiṃ majjhe, kiṃ pariyosānaṃ :
pli-tv-pvr13:5.2: codanāya okāsakammaṃ ādi, kiriyā majjhe, samatho pariyosānaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr13:5.3: codanāya kati mūlāni, kati vatthūni, kati bhūmiyo, katihākārehi codeti :
pli-tv-pvr13:5.4: codanāya dve mūlāni, tīṇi vatthūni, pañca bhūmiyo, dvīhākārehi codeti.
pli-tv-pvr13:5.12: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettācitto vakkhāmi no dosantaroti,
pli-tv-pvr13:6.2: kāyena vā codeti, vācāya vā codeti.
pli-tv-pvr13:7.6: codakena pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya paro codetabbo :
pli-tv-pvr13:7.7: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettācitto vakkhāmi no dosantaroti :
pli-tv-pvr13:7.17: anuvijjakena yena dhammena yena vinayena yena satthusāsanena taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasammati tathā taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametabbaṃ.
